title: The Deed, Scene 3 (from 'Shot Breakdown: The Deed, Scene 3', Part 1)
heading: SCENE 3 - INT. VILLAGE TEA SHOP - DUSK
note: The PDF gives the story, not the script's words: the blocks are its Scene 3 sentences, and it has no dialogue text, so no line ids.

blocks.text: Nimal meets Saman for tea. Saman is cheerful and talks about everything except the land.
Nimal notices a folded deed sticking out of Saman's shirt pocket.
He grabs it, stands, and slams it on the table: Saman has secretly sold the field.
Saman admits he did it to pay a debt he was too ashamed to mention.
